reactions: [Hacker News] Only way to justify those valuation is if they can achieve regulatory capture and outlaw competitors and open models. Expect the fear mongering to escalate to a fever pitch. The UN has no authority to ban anything but it's a good platform.
[Hacker News] If OpenAI voids its spending commitment, the bubble has to pop. I know the market is irrational, but that would be the clearest top signal ever
[Hacker News] They also access American models via proxies. Same as China
[Hacker News] Shocking publicity is good publicity. And "my product is so potent it will probably destroy you." I think I´ve heard it from drug dealers as well.
[Hacker News] They have access to all the same open models that the rest of the world does, so just fine I would think.
